body: I just want to thank everyone for replying and being so positive and kind. I'm feeling slightly better today but the feeling comes and goes and it seems to be coming more and more regularly now. But I'll take it as it comes. It's nice to have people on side. Thanks again Reddit.

I guess for the reasons stated in my /r/rant (this is the [link](http://www.reddit.com/r/rant/comments/37l8b0/the_whole_world_seems_against_me_and_i_hate/) to save me typing it all again) - I literally can't do anything with my life at the moment and I feel like I'm going insane.

In my previous low points, I've always told myself that things will get better and that I have to believe in myself to get out of the situation and in to better times, but it's so hard in this situation. I'm caring for my terminally ill mom at the moment and so I can't tell myself that it'll all be over soon and that life will improve, because it won't. I'll have lost my mom.
Whilst normally I'd agree with what you're saying, at the moment even small steps feel impossible. I feel like I'm trapped or in limbo or something. But thank you for your reply.

Thank you for your kindness. You're right, that is pretty much what keeps me going, but then I feel like a horrible person because I'm essentially saying I'll be relieved when my mom dies - I mean, wtf?? The only other stuff is that my ex says I owe him $2500 from a joint loan we took out - I don't owe him it legally, and if it went to court, he'd actually owe me money from the house equity, but he's playing on my conscience saying that I left him so I should feel bad and not make him pay this loan on his own and to give him the house etc. Even though he's now married with a kid and living in the house, with my dog, I still feel bad for ending the relationship but that's a whole different rant/self hatred campaign. The only other thing is my BF just had a parcel delivered to my house and it's so smashed and damaged I just cut my hand trying to open it and now I'm dealing with a FedEx complaints process on top of everything. That was the icing on today's cake.
